snippet.title: Hand Meat Walker (Unique Retro FPS/Boomer Shooter) | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and try the (quite long) demo on Steam! Planning release on April 9th.

A fast-paced, strategy driven retro FPS in which you fight alongside a robot companion. Explore chunky, old school style maps and battle bizarre creatures together. Bring demise with your well-rounded arsenal and powerful ally.

#fps #retrofps #boomershooter #indiegame
